faq.subtitle: Questions that customers care about most

how_to_book.question: How to book repair services?
how_to_book.answer: You can book services through website, mobile app, or call our hotline. Just describe the problem and we will send suitable technicians to your location.

pricing.question: How is service cost calculated?
pricing.answer: Service cost is calculated based on type of work, execution time, and necessary materials. You will receive detailed quotes before execution.

guarantee.question: Is service quality guaranteed?
guarantee.answer: We commit to 100% quality guarantee. If not satisfied, you can request free rework or get a refund.

response_time.question: What is the fastest response time?
response_time.answer: For emergency services, we can be there within 30-60 minutes. Regular services will be scheduled on the same day or next day.
